_: KOKORODROID: the voices that ride in the APK, in the picker's order (owner pick 2026-10-09: af_bella is the house voice; then heart, michael). Mirrors iOS voiceshop voices/bundled.json (same revision + pins). voice/fetch-voice.sh fetches each from hexgrad/Kokoro-82M at `revision`, checks the .pt against `pt_sha256`, and writes assets/voices/kokoro/packs/<id>.bin (510 x 256 float32, 522,240 bytes) + <id>.json + index.json.
